statusVocabulary.implemented: Real tables, real migrations, safe to generate against
statusVocabulary.stubbed: Table shape defined, no business logic; generation allowed but flagged
statusVocabulary.planned: No table; generation refused unless explicitly overridden

invariants: Every table belongs to exactly one domain
Every table belongs to exactly one context
Every context dependency references a valid context+version
Every flow references valid contexts, actors, products
Every product references valid contexts and flows
Every composition includes the full spine
No duplicate table IDs, flow IDs, context IDs, product IDs
No cycles in context or product graphs
No implemented table depends on a planned table
No implemented context depends on a planned context
